policy: committed data only: maker crawl tags, names, maker URLs and image names, and sibling catalog rows; a tag that says how a module is built or played (passive, touch) yields to one that says what it does; fill-null only; rows the committed data does not settle stay empty; no ModularGrid

entries.name: 2hp Passive Touch CTRL
entries.evidence: The name ('Touch CTRL') and the tags touch and control name a hand controller, which the catalog files under SEQ (NAME_CATEGORY 'controller', TAG_CATEGORY 'controller|touch'). 'passive' describes the circuit, not the job: the brand's other passive rows take their function's category (2hp Passive LPG V1 is VCA; Passive Mult., Crossfader and Attenuator are UTIL).
